scope: finite-field elliptic curve isogeny kernel cohomology under stated hypotheses
statement: For an F_p-rational separable isogeny of degree coprime to prime #E(F_p)=r, H^1(F_p, ker(phi)) is zero; this persists under prime-to-r composite chains. For phi=1-pi of degree r, the kernel cohomology is the rational group and the connecting class of Q is -Q.
